fix\(graph-store\): specify database via URI query parameter

The withDefaultDatabase\(\) method doesn''t exist in the current version
of laudis/neo4j-php-client. The correct approach is to append the
database as a query parameter to the connection URI.

Example: bolt://localhost:7687?database=mydb

The default ''neo4j'' database is handled by Neo4j automatically,
so we only append the parameter for non-default databases.
